description: PTC - proposta di tram provinciale is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sit.cittametropolitana.na.it. Metropolitan City of Naples. The layer represents the proposal of a tramway system at the service of the municipalities located north of Naples and as a system of adduction to the regional metro network; the proposed route is a backbone of the collective transport of the settlements of the areas located in the central part ... Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "PTC — proposal for provincial tram" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include PTC, Utilizzo del territorio, tram provinciale, Piano Territoriale Coordinamento, Città Metropolitana di Napoli, rete infrastrutturale mobilità. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
